# Context engineering (Addy Osmani)

Sets up what an agent sees so its output stays accurate and focused.

- Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/main/skills/context-engineering/SKILL.md
- Author: Addy Osmani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/context-engineering-addy-osmani-b3b5784d

Describes a context hierarchy: rules files, specs and architecture notes, relevant source files, error output and conversation management. It gives a rules-file template and packing strategies such as a brain dump, a selective include and a hierarchical project map, plus advice on managing the context budget and when to restart a session. Use it at the start of a project, when switching tasks or when output quality drops.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a CLAUDE.md for this repo following the context hierarchy"
- "The agent keeps losing track in this long session. Help me restructure context"
- "Build a project map so the agent can find the right files"
